interval_method: Two-sided empirical Bernstein bounds with Bonferroni correction; paired question clusters.
scope: Unmodified-page check on the 18 previously authored award-experiment questions. Unseen by candidate paid tuning; finite task-set evidence, not representative ChatGPT population validation.

interpretation: Confidence is coverage of registered metric bounds under the sampling assumptions; it is not a probability that two agents are identical or that results transfer to all future designs.

precision_plan.notice: Optimistic precision floor assuming zero difference and zero variance (perfect reliability for quality gates). Actual variance or a gap increases sample requirements; a gap outside tolerance requires a design change. Counts are independent questions per scope, not model repetitions. This is not a power calculation.

coverage.notice: URL overlap ignores query, scheme and fragment. It does not establish identical content, complete candidate coverage or actual reading.

provenance_note: Allowlisted numeric export of real recorded runs. Raw snapshots, API responses and traces remain private. Exploratory trials reusing hosted responses are not independent validations.
